The peaks in this Indonesian region on the world's second-largest island, just north of Australia, have offered scientists countless insights into the Earth's climate history. They're also the epicentre of the spiritual universe for many Papuans - a Mecca or a Vatican, as one activist puts it. But now, nearly all the snow is gone. A century ago, the 300km (190-mile) stretch of the Sudirman Range had snow and permanent ice on all four of its major peaks. But now there are only small areas around Puncak Jaya, also known as Carstensz Pyramid, with any snow at all. These are expected to entirely disappear in a year or two. Glacier cover around the peak has shrunk from nearly 1,900 hectares (4,700 acres) in the 19th Century to about 16 hectares (40 acres) today. Almost entire glaciers have vanished within a human lifetime. "There is a profound unfairness in this," says Marie Šabacká, a Czech glacier ecologist who travelled to Puncak Jaya last March in a bid to be among the last scientists to study Papua's "eternal snow". She says the tropical glaciers in Papua are unique because they are separated from other glacier systems by thousands of kilometres. Papua is home to the "last remaining tropical ice" between the Andes and Himalayas. Ice cores taken from the slopes of Puncak Jaya preserve a record of climate history. full_text: موعد مباراة قطر ضد الإمارات في خليجي 27 والقنوات الناقلة نستعرض تفاصيل القمة الخليجية بين قطر والإمارات في الجولة الثالثة من دور المجموعات في خليجي 27. حفظ شارِكْ يلتقي منتخب قطر نظيره الإماراتي يوم الأربعاء 30 سبتمبر/أيلول 2026، على ملعب مدينة الملك عبد الله الرياضية في جدة، ضمن الجولة الثالثة والأخيرة من منافسات المجموعة الثانية في بطولة خليجي 27. وتنطلق المباراة في تمام الساعة 20:30 بتوقيت السعودية وقطر، في مواجهة مرتقبة بين منتخبين ضمنا حتى الآن حصد 6 نقاط من مباراتين. كما يمكنكم متابعة تغطية حية ومباشرة لتفاصيل القمة الخليجية عبر موقعنا الجزيرة نت. ويتصدر منتخب الإمارات المجموعة بفارق الأهداف، بعدما سجل 7 أهداف ولم تستقبل شباكه أي هدف، بينما يحتل منتخب قطر المركز الثاني برصيد 6 نقاط، وسجل هدفين دون أن تهتز شباكه. ويحتاج المنتخب القطري إلى تحقيق نتيجة إيجابية في هذه المواجهة للحفاظ على موقعه في سباق الصدارة، في حين يسعى المنتخب الإماراتي إلى مواصلة انتصاراته وإنهاء دور المجموعات في المركز الأول.

The rerelease of “Where Is the Friend’s House?” in Greece began on August 27, and the two Athens screenings were part of its ongoing theatrical run in the country. The film tells the story of Ahmad, a young schoolboy in a rural village who mistakenly takes home his classmate’s notebook. Concerned that his friend may be punished for not having his homework, Ahmad sets out for a neighboring village to return the notebook. Through the seemingly simple journey of a child, Kiarostami explores themes of friendship, responsibility, and compassion, while offering an understated portrayal of rural life and childhood. Officials note that more than 20 agencies are involved in border and trade processes, and not all delays originate with customs. Coordinated border management seeks better inter-agency cooperation and less duplication, while seamless transport aims to move goods from entry points to destinations with fewer unnecessary stops.
